commands.output:
usage: pallaquino [-h] [--version]
                  {status,doctor,analyze,plan,agents,skills,pipeline,checkpoint,handoff,resume,validate,stack,risk,graph,security,identity,contracts,run,cancel,pause,approve,memory,providers,executions,plugins,plugin,mcp,tools,permissions,init}
                  ...

PALLAQUINO Autonomous Engineering OS

positional arguments:
  {status,doctor,analyze,plan,agents,skills,pipeline,checkpoint,handoff,resume,validate,stack,risk,graph,security,identity,contracts,run,cancel,pause,approve,memory,providers,executions,plugins,plugin,mcp,tools,permissions,init}
    status              show current framework state
    doctor              diagnose framework and environment
    analyze             build a repository map
    plan                plan a request (DAG of tasks) or show the legacy
                        execution plan
    agents              list registered agents or match a request to agents
    skills              list registered skills
    pipeline            show strict pipeline state
    checkpoint          create a continuity checkpoint
    handoff             create a provider-neutral handoff
    resume              resume an execution (--execution) or recover the
                        newest checkpoint
    validate            run all framework validators
    stack               show verified stack freshness
    risk                classify request risk
    graph               show and validate the task graph
    security            read-only security audit (secret scan) of a target
    identity            show, set or apply the project commit identity
    contracts           report agent/skill contract coverage or show one
                        verified contract
    run                 execute a validated plan
    cancel              cancel an execution
    pause               pause an execution
    approve             approve governed tools of a waiting task
    memory              inspect, search and manage project memory
    providers           list providers or diagnose their configuration
    executions          list executions or report, trace and export one
    plugins             discover, validate, trust, enable and manage plugins
    plugin              plugin SDK: create, validate or test a plugin
    mcp                 configure, test and review MCP server connections
    tools               list, inspect, check, route and run tools through the
                        gateway
    permissions         list, grant, revoke and audit tool permissions
    init                copy PALLAQUINO into a repository

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit
